subjectEvidencePilot.subject: EMA
subjectEvidencePilot.seed: must declare first-value vs SMA-seeded convention and warmup
subjectEvidencePilot.limits: Seed differences and missing bars change early values; no signal efficacy inferred

subjectEvidencePilot.subject: VWAP_PRINTS
subjectEvidencePilot.seed: initialize at reset, require positive aggregate volume
subjectEvidencePilot.limits: Not identical to OHLCV HLC3 proxy; timestamp eligibility required

subjectEvidencePilot.subject: VWAP_OHLCV_PROXY
subjectEvidencePilot.inputWindow: completed OHLCV bars and declared session
subjectEvidencePilot.seed: require positive volume, label approximation and reset
subjectEvidencePilot.limits: Cannot reconstruct exact transaction VWAP from candles

subjectEvidencePilot.subject: SMA
subjectEvidencePilot.seed: not defined before n bars; no forward fill without policy
subjectEvidencePilot.limits: Lag, sessions, missing bars, incomplete candles

subjectEvidencePilot.subject: RSI
subjectEvidencePilot.seed: first n gains/losses averaged; subsequent Wilder updates; neutral 0/0 defined as 50 in our existing math
subjectEvidencePilot.limits: Wilder smoothing differs from SMA/EMA methods; loss=0 boundary and inadequate warmup

subjectEvidencePilot.subject: MACD
subjectEvidencePilot.inputWindow: fast/slow completed close history and trailing macd signal history
subjectEvidencePilot.seed: declare each SMA-seeded EMA and delay signal until complete MACD history
subjectEvidencePilot.limits: EMA warmup and chosen periods change first valid MACD and histogram

subjectEvidencePilot.subject: ATR
subjectEvidencePilot.seed: initial true range uses first bar high-low; first n TR mean then Wilder smoothing
subjectEvidencePilot.limits: gap-aware TR, warmup and first-bar treatment must be declared

subjectEvidencePilot.subject: BOLLINGER
subjectEvidencePilot.seed: population standard deviation n; no band until n bars
subjectEvidencePilot.limits: sample versus population variance and missing bars differ by vendor

subjectEvidencePilot.subject: EXPECTANCY
subjectEvidencePilot.inputWindow: fictional binary-outcome set and net per-trade costs
subjectEvidencePilot.limits: not a prediction; win frequency estimated from biased/small samples may be misleading

subjectEvidencePilot.subject: POSITION_SIZING
subjectEvidencePilot.inputWindow: hypothetical buy entry, stop reference, cash budget, risk budget
subjectEvidencePilot.seed: long cash-only cap; entry>stop>0 and both budgets finite; zero risk distance invalid
subjectEvidencePilot.limits: not an executable fill, actual loss cap or substitute for slippage/fees/gaps/margin regulations
